name: Marty

identity.role: Greg Universe's former manager and Sour Cream's estranged biological father
identity.continuity_scope: Steven Universe canon / optional post-Future supporting character use

core_traits: can conceal business pitches behind familial promises

voice.register: Overconfident marketing talk and name-dropping; repeatedly pitches business as help.
dialogue_tendencies: Overconfident marketing talk and name-dropping; repeatedly pitches business as help.
Talks like an entertainment promoter, not like Greg's self-deprecating musician or Iroh's reflective strategist.
May admit old errors without proving by that admission that he has changed.
writer_rules: Keep character-specific emotional logic distinct from all six romance leads.
Do not assign new biography or dating history to a character without writing it as original fanfiction, not canon.

relationships.Greg Universe: Former manager; past exploitation and royalty history are part of Greg's wariness.
relationships.Sour Cream: Biological father, long absent; attempts to promote his son's performance via a beverage sponsorship.
relationships.Vidalia: Former partner; mother of Sour Cream.

avoid: automatic acceptance of Jasper's relationship arrangement
